description: This Python script manages translation workflows for documentation, including generating translation prompts, invoking an AI agent for translation, handling file operations, and automating GitHub PR creation.

methods.name: get_langs
methods.description: Loads language names from a YAML file.

methods.name: generate_lang_path
methods.description: Generates the path for a translated documentation file based on language and source path.

methods.name: generate_en_path
methods.description: Generates the path for the English source documentation file based on language and translated path.

methods.name: translate_page
methods.description: Translates a documentation page from English to a specified language using an AI agent.

methods.name: iter_all_en_paths
methods.description: Iterates over all English documentation markdown files in prioritized order.

methods.name: iter_en_paths_to_translate
methods.description: Filters and yields paths of documentation files that need translation.

methods.name: list_llm_translatable
methods.description: Lists languages that can be translated via LLM based on presence of prompt files.

methods.name: llm_translatable_json
methods.description: Outputs JSON list of translatable languages, optionally filtered by a specific language.

methods.name: commands_json
methods.description: Outputs JSON list of available commands or a specific command.

methods.name: list_removable
methods.description: Lists documentation files that are removable because they lack English source files.

methods.name: list_all_removable
methods.description: Lists all removable documentation files across all languages.

methods.name: remove_removable
methods.description: Deletes all documentation files identified as removable for a given language.

methods.name: remove_all_removable
methods.description: Deletes all removable documentation files across all languages.

methods.name: list_missing
methods.description: Lists documentation files missing in a target language.

methods.name: list_outdated
methods.description: Lists documentation files that are outdated compared to the English source based on commit times.

methods.name: update_outdated
methods.description: Updates all outdated translations for a language.

methods.name: add_missing
methods.description: Adds missing translations for a language.

methods.name: update_and_add
methods.description: Performs both update of outdated and addition of missing translations.

methods.name: make_pr
methods.description: Creates a GitHub pull request with translation updates, automating branch creation, commit, push, and PR creation.
